title_alternatives: Why Dollar Stores Are Actually the Priciest
The Dollar Store Unit Price Trap Nobody Talks About
youtube_short.description: Dollar stores feel like a deal — but per ounce, per serving, per use, they're often the most expensive store in your zip code. Dollar store laundry detergent runs 22¢/oz vs 6¢/oz at bulk stores. That's nearly 4x the price for the exact same clean. If you spend $60/month on household basics there, you're overpaying $1,400/year — and $140,000 over a working life. The $1.25 sticker is hiding one of retail's highest per-unit markups, and 73% of these stores deliberately cluster in neighborhoods with the fewest alternatives. #moneytips #personalfinance #savemoney Follow for more money traps dressed up as savings.

hook_line: Dollar stores cost MORE per ounce
